title: crm.product.compensate-sale-products, payload v1 (COMMAND)
description: Compensation (ADR-018 §5): passivate the PNDG products this saga created. Destination: crm.product.cmd.compensate-sale-products.v1. Sale-scoped by construction — the consumer refuses any product whose saleOperationId is not this order number (409 MSG-SALE-OPERATION-MISMATCH), so one saga can never passivate another's products even if handed their ids. NOT the KR-7 product cancellation, which stays out of phase (ADR-015 §5.7).

orderNumber.description: The sagaId, and the saleOperationId every named product must be owned by.

productIds.description: May be EMPTY: a sale can fail before any product existed, and the consumer answers SUCCEEDED for it — 'there was nothing to undo' is a completed compensation, and the orchestrator is waiting for that answer.
